name: jamf-pro-mcp
description: Every client's Jamf Pro in one CLI: register each instance once, then find devices, check posture and patch status, and audit policies across all of them.

jamf_pro_client_id.title: Jamf Pro API client ID
jamf_pro_client_id.description: The client ID of a Jamf Pro API client (Settings > System > API roles and clients).

jamf_pro_client_secret.title: Jamf Pro API client secret
jamf_pro_client_secret.description: The client secret of that Jamf Pro API client.

jamf_pro_server.title: Jamf Pro server
jamf_pro_server.description: Your Jamf Pro server host, for example acme.jamfcloud.com.

jamf_pro_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
jamf_pro_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

jamf_pro_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
jamf_pro_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

jamf_pro_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
jamf_pro_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

jamf_pro_base_url.title: Base URL override
jamf_pro_base_url.description: Optional. Overrides the API base URL; leave blank to use your Jamf Pro server.

jamf_pro_oauth_scope.title: OAuth scope
jamf_pro_oauth_scope.description: Optional. Scope sent when requesting a token; leave blank unless your API client needs one.

jamf_pro_fleet_dir.title: Instance registry folder
jamf_pro_fleet_dir.description: Optional. Folder holding the registry of client instances; leave blank for the default.

jamf_pro_fleet_secrets.title: Fleet client secrets (optional)
jamf_pro_fleet_secrets.description: Optional. Client secrets for the instances you registered with 'jamf-pro-cli instance add', as name=secret pairs separated by commas (acme=SECRET1,globex=SECRET2). Needed only for the fleet tools and an instance pin. Leave blank for one server.

jamf_pro_instance.title: Pin to one registered instance (optional)
jamf_pro_instance.description: Optional. Name of an instance registered with 'jamf-pro-cli instance add' to point every single-server tool at; its secret comes from the fleet client secrets. Leave blank to use the Jamf Pro server above.

jamf_pro_user_agent.title: User-Agent override
jamf_pro_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent header sent to Jamf Pro; leave blank for the default.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
